facts.claim: Becoming self-aware by viewing one's own Facebook profile enhances self-esteem.
facts.quote: becoming self-aware by viewing one's own Facebook profile enhances self-esteem rather than diminishes it.

facts.claim: Participants that updated their profiles and viewed their own profiles during the experiment also reported greater self-esteem.
facts.quote: Participants that updated their profiles and viewed their own profiles during the experiment also reported greater self-esteem

facts.claim: The substitution of language for nonverbal cues in text-based computer-mediated communication systems transforms users’ reception, self-presentation, composition, and reciprocal reinforcement of messages in ways that create socially desirable relationships online.
facts.quote: the substitution of language for nonverbal cues, necessitated by text-based computer-mediated communication systems, transforms users’ reception, self-presentation, composition, and reciprocal reinforcement of messages in ways that create socially desirable relationships online.

facts.claim: Selective self-presentation in digital media is linked to intensified relationship formation.
facts.quote: selective self-presentation in digital media, which leads to intensified relationship formation, also influences impressions of the self.

facts.claim: Video calling software allowed people to achieve greater closeness and connection with friends and family during the COVID-19 pandemic.
facts.quote: For many people, video calling software had become especially important, allowing them to achieve greater closeness and connection with their friends and family

facts.claim: Digital communication technologies had an increased presence in people’s domestic lives during lockdown.
facts.quote: Digital communication technologies had an increased presence in people’s domestic lives during lockdown.

research.angle: While some theories suggest digital media might corrode intimacy, evidence shows that digital tools can enhance self-esteem, create socially desirable relationships, and facilitate greater closeness during periods of physical isolation.
research.verdict: The evidence suggests that digital communication can actually enhance self-esteem and foster closeness rather than simply reducing the rewards of face-to-face interaction.
research.caveat: The sources do not provide data on the neurological rewards of deep, focused face-to-face interaction or the specific impact of high-frequency low-effort messaging.
